command:
$ErrorActionPreference='Continue'
$tmp=[System.IO.Path]::GetTempFileName()
foreach ($d in @('docker-desktop','Ubuntu')) {
  Write-Output "--- $d ---"
  $p=Start-Process -FilePath 'wsl.exe' -ArgumentList @('-d',$d,'sh','/mnt/c/Users/bs/p40-commissioning/wslprobe.sh') -NoNewWindow -Wait -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$tmp.o" -RedirectStandardError "$tmp.e"
  Write-Output "EXIT=$($p.ExitCode)"
  (Get-Content "$tmp.o" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
  (Get-Content "$tmp.e" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue) -join "`n"
}
Remove-Item "$tmp*" -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
Write-Output '--- RC ---'
